model_prompt:
Based on the eval cases and research brief for engineer-copilot-agent SKILL.md, provide an improved version of the skill that:

1. Clarifies when to use the skill (make triggering criteria more specific)
2. Reduces redundancy between sections (core workflow, four concern separation, recursive minimization loop)
3. Makes the workflow more principles-driven than procedure-driven
4. Adds concrete examples of common agent issues and their fixes
5. Improves evals guidance with more specific failure-mode patterns

Existing eval cases focus on:
- Agent creation with discovery-first approach and concern separation
- Auditing and fixing stale agent contracts with regression evals
- Recursive minimization of bloated agent prompts
- Bounded handoff orchestration with discovery
- Routing resilience to helper-name drift

Key principles from the research:
- Discovery-first pattern (always verify before hardcoding)
- Concern separation (frontmatter, routing, handoffs, minimization)
- MCP skill ordering (discover-load-run pattern)
- Minimization stop condition (body should only contain routing/ownership)
- Live inventory priority (session overrides repo snapshot)
- Deterministic validation before changes

Improve the SKILL.md by making it more actionable and less redundant while preserving all essential guidance.
